purpose: Teach: 乳児/遺骨/銃弾/勾留/留置/採血/病的/課さ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、乳児向け商品の品質を最優先しろ
lines.en: Quality on our infant product line comes first. Make it the top priority.
lines.style: Clipped opening command. Firm, decisive attack, no wasted syllables, weight landing on the final phrase.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。戦災遺骨収集事業に寄付します
lines.en: Yes, sir. We'll donate to the war-remains recovery project.
lines.style: Prompt, crisp acknowledgment. Quick yes, then efficient even delivery of the follow-through.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、社員の銃弾事故、つまり銃弾保険にも対応しろ
lines.en: And get us covered for bullet incidents involving staff — bullet insurance, that is.
lines.style: Brisk directive with a beat before the clarification. Firm, forward-leaning pace throughout.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員の勾留事案には法務部が対応します
lines.en: Yes, sir. Legal will handle any case of an employee being held in detention.
lines.style: Steady procedural reply. Even pace, faint dry confidence that Legal has it covered.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、社内留置スペース、つまり保管室を整えろ
lines.en: Sort out our internal holding space — the storage room, I mean.
lines.style: Short, impatient energy. Quick self-correction on the clarifying phrase, the order snapped shut at the end.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員定期検診で採血を含めます
lines.en: Yes, sir. We'll include blood draws in the employees' regular checkups.
lines.style: Efficient, unruffled confirmation. Measured pace, ticking the item off almost audibly.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、病的なクレーマー対策を強化しろ
lines.en: Strengthen our measures against pathological complainers.
lines.style: Harder edge on the word pathological. Decisive downward finish, the directive landing like a gavel.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。法令で課された開示義務に従います
lines.en: Yes, sir. We'll comply with every disclosure obligation imposed by law.
lines.style: Calm closing compliance. Even, reliable delivery, a quiet settling as the meeting wraps up.
